section: Specifying remote pipelines, tasks, and step actions using resolvers
job_statement: When building CI/CD pipelines, I want to reuse existing pipeline and task definitions from various sources, so I can avoid duplicating code and leverage community-tested solutions.
desired_outcomes: Minimize time spent recreating common pipeline tasks
Reduce likelihood of errors from copy-paste mistakes
Ensure access to latest versions of reusable components
Increase pipeline maintainability through centralized definitions
evidence: create-combined.adoc -> Specifying remote pipelines, tasks, and step actions using resolvers, lines 2176-2181: 'Pipelines and tasks are reusable blocks for your CI/CD processes. You can reuse pipelines or tasks that you developed before, or that were developed by others, without having to copy and paste their definitions.'
notes: Main job covering all resolver types. This is the overarching goal - reusing existing pipeline/task definitions.
